summary: Comprehensive testing of Dubai Exchange Admin Panel. Backend: 33/33 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All admin pages working correctly. Fixed 1 backend bug (OrderStatsResponse missing pending_review and ignored fields).
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed bug in /app/backend/routes/orders.py - get_order_stats() was missing pending_review and ignored fields in OrderStatsResponse
All admin pages load correctly with proper Arabic RTL layout
Order detail modal shows all required fields: customer info, order details, admin data tabs, action buttons
Airports page has 4 tabs: Airports, Border Crossings, Company Stamps, Signatures
Exchange rates page shows buy/sell rates for 8 currencies with edit functionality
Services page shows Hero services and additional services with CRUD operations
Blocklist page has add/remove functionality with block reasons
Countries page shows transfer countries with flags and transfer methods
seed_data_creation: Test data created during backend tests with TEST_ prefix, cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin panel fully tested. All CRUD operations working. Order status update and admin_data update APIs verified. Blocklist add/remove working. Airports/Stamps CRUD working. Services, Countries, Rates management working.

admin_login.details: Login with developer@khairbaghdad.com / dev@123456 works correctly, redirects to /admin dashboard

admin_dashboard.details: Dashboard shows order statistics (total, waiting_payment, under_review, approved, rejected), recent orders table, sidebar navigation

orders_traveler.details: /admin/orders/traveler shows 10 traveler orders with order ID, customer name, phone, amount, status, date

orders_international.details: /admin/orders/international shows international transfer orders (WU, MG, country-based)

orders_cards.details: /admin/orders/cards page loads (1 card recharge order exists)

order_detail_modal.details: Order detail modal shows customer info, order details, admin data tabs, action buttons (Accept, Reject, Ignore, Block Customer, Print)

order_status_update_api.details: PUT /api/orders/{order_id} with status field updates order status correctly

order_admin_data_update_api.details: PUT /api/orders/{order_id} with admin_data field updates admin-only fields (batch_number, mother_name, etc.)

blocklist_page.details: /admin/blocklist shows blocklist with add button, empty state when no blocked users

blocklist_add_api.details: POST /api/blocklist/ adds customer to blocklist with reason

blocklist_check_api.details: GET /api/blocklist/check verifies if customer is blocked

airports_page.details: /admin/airports shows 4 tabs: Airports (5 Iraqi airports), Border Crossings, Company Stamps, Signatures

airports_crud_api.details: Create, update, delete stamps/airports working correctly

services_page.details: /admin/services shows Hero services and additional services with edit/delete/toggle buttons

countries_page.details: /admin/countries shows transfer countries with flags and transfer methods

countries_api.details: GET /api/cms/countries returns countries list, GET /api/cms/countries/{code} returns specific country

rates_page.details: /admin/rates shows exchange rates table with 8 currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, TRY, AED, SAR, JOD, EGP) with buy/sell rates

auth_api.details: POST /api/auth/login returns access_token and user info, GET /api/auth/me returns current user

order_stats_api.details: GET /api/orders/stats/summary returns total_orders, pending_review, waiting_payment, under_review, approved, rejected, ignored, by_type

bugs_fixed.issue: get_order_stats() was missing pending_review and ignored fields in OrderStatsResponse, causing 500 error
bugs_fixed.fix: Added pending_review and ignored fields to both empty response and populated response

mocked_apis.sms_service: SMS service via UniMTX is configured but templates are pending approval from provider
